historical_references.reference: The last Bishop of Zurich before the Reformation was Conrad Widmer. He ruled from 1516 to 1525. During his tenure, Zurich became a center of the Protestant Reformation under the leadership of Ulrich Zwingli. Widmer's inability to quell the spreading Reformation movement eventually led to his resignation.
historical_references.context: Last Catholic Bishop of Zurich before the Reformation

historical_references.reference: Ulrich Zwingli, a Swiss theologian and pastor, emerged as the leading figure in the early Protestant Reformation in Zurich. Following the teachings of Martin Luther, Zwingli initiated the Reformation in Zurich in 1523. He rejected the Catholic Mass and introduced vernacular sermons and hymns into his services.
